create_tweet_screenshot.description: Render a clean screenshot image of a public tweet and get back a link to the image. Paste a tweet's URL or ID and pick a light or dark theme.
create_tweet_screenshot.display_str_template: Create a TwitterShots screenshot of tweet {tweet}.
create_tweet_screenshot.name: create_tweet_screenshot

parameters.description: The tweet to screenshot. Paste its full URL (for example https://x.com/user/status/123456789) or just its numeric ID.
parameters.name: tweet

parameters.description: The colour theme of the screenshot.
parameters.name: theme

parameters.description: The image format to render. PNG works on every plan; SVG requires a paid plan.
parameters.name: image_format

format.description: The image format that was rendered.

image_url.description: Link to the rendered screenshot image.

tweet_id.description: The ID of the tweet that was captured.

description: Turn any public tweet into a clean screenshot image with TwitterShots: no Twitter/X developer account required.
